title: Schedule of Taxes Returned by the Term a Ticket Stood — Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
**Air Ticket Fare Brands — footnote to the tax and carrier fee lines of the tariff.**

The share at which the tax lines on a booking the traveller has given up are returned follows how long the ticket stood before the cancellation was confirmed, and that share is what settles the amount the tax lines are returned at. How long the ticket stood is counted in whole days from the day the ticket was issued to the day the cancellation was confirmed.

| How long the ticket stood | The amount the tax lines are returned at |
| --- | --- |
| The long-held term of 120 whole days or longer | the tax lines posted on the booking taken at the long-held share of 0.75 |
| The standard-held term of 30 whole days or longer, but short of 120 whole days | the tax lines posted on the booking taken at the standard-held share of 0.90 |
| Shorter than 30 whole days | the tax lines posted on the booking in full |

Each term is read on both of its sides. A ticket that stood exactly 120 whole days has reached the long-held term, and the amount its tax lines are returned at is those lines taken at the long-held share of 0.75; a ticket that stood 119 whole days has not reached that term, and, having stood 30 whole days or longer, the amount its tax lines are returned at is those lines taken at the standard-held share of 0.90. A ticket that stood exactly 30 whole days has reached the standard-held term, and the amount its tax lines are returned at is settled at that share of 0.90; a ticket that stood 29 whole days has not reached it, and the amount its tax lines are returned at is those lines in full.

On hypothetical dates: a ticket issued on the first day of a month and cancelled on the thirty-first day of that same month stood 30 whole days, and the amount its tax lines are returned at is settled at the standard-held share of 0.90; had the cancellation been confirmed on the thirtieth day of that month, the ticket would have stood 29 whole days and the amount the tax lines are returned at would be those lines in full.
